decks.notes: This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on early creature aggression and disruption, utilizing cards like Archon of Emeria and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to slow down opponents, while also generating value with Collected Company and Skyclave Apparition. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient creature curve, supported by ramping mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves. With the ability to disrupt opponents' game plans and quickly build a board presence, this deck aims to establish dominance early in the game and maintain pressure throughout.
